-- Insert aluminum soffit option
INSERT INTO soffit_materials (slug, name, description, materialCostPerSqft, installCostPerSqft, marginPct, pricePerSqft, laborPricePerSqft, sortOrder, isActive)
VALUES ('aluminum', 'Aluminum Soffit', 'Standard aluminum soffit panels for underside deck finishing', 3.50, 2.50, 35.00, 9.23, 2.50, 40, 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name);

-- Update existing soffit items to have materialCostPerSqft and installCostPerSqft
-- (migrate from old pricePerSqft + laborPricePerSqft to new cost model)
UPDATE soffit_materials SET
  materialCostPerSqft = CASE
    WHEN slug = 'tng-wood' THEN 4.50
    WHEN slug = 'tng-pvc' THEN 5.50
    WHEN slug = 'standard-aluminum' THEN 2.80
    WHEN slug = 'painted-cement-board' THEN 3.20
    ELSE materialCostPerSqft
  END,
  installCostPerSqft = CASE
    WHEN slug = 'tng-wood' THEN 3.00
    WHEN slug = 'tng-pvc' THEN 3.00
    WHEN slug = 'standard-aluminum' THEN 2.00
    WHEN slug = 'painted-cement-board' THEN 2.50
    ELSE installCostPerSqft
  END
WHERE slug IN ('tng-wood', 'tng-pvc', 'standard-aluminum', 'painted-cement-board');

-- Recalculate pricePerSqft for all soffit items using (material + install) / (1 - margin/100)
UPDATE soffit_materials SET
  pricePerSqft = ROUND((materialCostPerSqft + installCostPerSqft) / (1 - marginPct / 100), 2)
WHERE materialCostPerSqft > 0 OR installCostPerSqft > 0;

SELECT slug, name, materialCostPerSqft, installCostPerSqft, marginPct, pricePerSqft FROM soffit_materials ORDER BY sortOrder;
